profile_text.body:
The website associated with this record is that of Dexus, an Australasian real asset investment and funds management business. Dexus describes four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and describes a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It states that Dexus Funds Management Limited (ACN 060 920 783, AFSL No. 238163) is the responsible entity of Dexus (ASX: DXS) and the issuer of stapled securities in the Fund, which comprises two registered schemes, Dexus Property Trust (ARSN 648 526 470) and Dexus Operations Trust (ARSN 110 521 223). The site presents general information only and notes that past performance is not a reliable indicator of future performance.

The held record identifies the company as DXC Technology Co, a for-profit public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with the ticker DXC and CIK 0001688568. The record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. It records a law exposure count of 152 for Virginia.

The harvested site text and the held company identity do not match: the site content describes Dexus and its funds, while the record names DXC Technology Co. No AI products or AI position are described in the available material.
